nodes.label: Leather Armor Texture (Sheet 1)
nodes.description: Minecraft-style leather armor UV-map texture sheet. Shows segmented armor piece outlines (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) arranged in a sprite layout. Color palette: warm mid-tone browns, tans, and beige with darker seam/edge detail lines. Used to skin the player entity's equipped leather armor layer.

nodes.label: Leather Armor Texture (Sheet 2 / Overlay)
nodes.description: Secondary leather armor UV-map sheet, likely the overlay/tint layer that allows dye color customization (Minecraft dye mechanic). Mostly flat near-white/transparent base so that a runtime color tint can be applied. Sparse pixel detail with a single thin horizontal stripe. Intended to composite on top of armor_leather to produce colored leather armor.

nodes.label: Barrel Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style barrel block side face texture. Depicts vertical wood plank strips (warm medium-brown tones) with two dark horizontal metal hoop bands running around the barrel, giving the classic wooden-stave-and-hoop barrel appearance. Color palette: medium brown planks, near-black/dark-grey hoops. Used as the lateral face of barrel blocks placed in the game world.

nodes.label: Barrel Top Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style barrel block top face texture. Shows the circular cross-section of a wooden barrel from above: concentric rings of wood staves forming a rounded top with a dark center knot or lid detail. Color palette: warm medium brown and lighter tan planks, dark center accent. Used as the top/bottom face of barrel blocks.

nodes.label: Basalt Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style basalt block side texture. Displays a dark volcanic rock pattern with vertical striation lines running top to bottom, consistent with basalt's columnar formation. Color palette: dark charcoal, near-black, and very dark grey with slight cool-blue undertones. Used for nether or volcanic environment decoration blocks.

nodes.label: Bone Block Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style bone block lateral face texture. Shows a flat, nearly uniform off-white/cream color with very subtle horizontal banding lines suggesting layered bone material. Color palette: pale cream, ivory, off-white. Used as the side face of bone blocks, which are crafted from bone meal and used for decoration or as a Nether biome block.

nodes.label: Bone Block Top Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style bone block top face texture. Flat off-white/pale yellow-cream surface with a subtle circular or concentric ring motif representing the cross-section of a bone. Very similar tone to the side but with a slightly different central pattern. Color palette: cream, ivory, pale yellow-white. Used as the top/bottom face of bone blocks.

nodes.label: Cactus Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style cactus block side texture. Shows the green ribbed surface of a cactus with darker green vertical grooves and small white/light-yellow spine dots protruding from the surface. Color palette: medium and dark green with light spine highlights. Used as the lateral face of cactus blocks, a desert plant block that deals damage on contact.

nodes.label: Cactus Top Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style cactus block top face texture. Depicts the cross-section of a cactus from above with a star or radial pattern of dark green ridges on a medium green field, and small spine dots around the outer edge. Color palette: medium green, dark green ridges, tiny white/light spine specks. Used as the top face of cactus blocks.

nodes.label: Chiseled Deepslate Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style chiseled deepslate block texture. Shows a dark grey stone face with a carved/chiseled decorative motif — typically a circular or ammonite-like fossil embossed pattern at the center surrounded by a beveled border frame. Color palette: dark grey, near-black, with slightly lighter grey highlights on the carved relief. Used as a decorative stonework block in cave or dungeon environments.

nodes.label: Cobbled Deepslate Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture depicting rough, cobblestone-style deepslate. Dark blue-grey palette with jagged, irregular stone chunks and visible crevices. Used as a mined/natural variant of deepslate for flooring, walls, or dungeon construction.
nodes.pattern: irregular cobble chunks, rough stone texture
nodes.game_purpose: natural deepslate cobble block, used in underground biomes and dungeon construction

nodes.label: Cracked Deepslate Bricks Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture showing deepslate bricks with visible crack lines running through them. Dark charcoal/slate-grey color with linear fractures overlaid on a brick grid pattern. Used to convey aged or damaged stonework in dungeon environments.
nodes.pattern: brick grid with overlaid crack fracture lines
nodes.game_purpose: aged/damaged deepslate brick block, dungeon aesthetic, structural decay indicator

nodes.label: Cut Sandstone Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of smooth cut sandstone. Warm tan/beige color palette with subtle horizontal banding and a fine-grained sandy surface pattern. Used for decorative desert-themed construction and flooring.
nodes.pattern: smooth surface with subtle horizontal band lines, fine grain
nodes.game_purpose: decorative sandstone block, desert/temple architecture, flooring and walls

nodes.label: Dark Oak Planks Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of dark oak wood planks. Deep brown/mahogany color palette with horizontal wood grain lines and plank seams. Used for dark-themed wooden construction such as mansions and dungeon interiors.
nodes.pattern: horizontal plank seams with wood grain detail
nodes.game_purpose: dark wood plank block, used in dark oak structures, mansions, and dungeon flooring

nodes.label: Deepslate Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of base deepslate stone (side face). Dark grey/charcoal with subtle layered strata lines giving a compressed sedimentary rock appearance. Used for underground cave and dungeon walls at deep depths.
nodes.pattern: subtle horizontal strata/layering with slight noise
nodes.game_purpose: base deep underground stone block, found below y=0, used for cave generation and dungeon walls

nodes.label: Deepslate Bricks Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of polished deepslate bricks. Dark slate-grey with a regular brick grid pattern, mortar lines clearly visible as lighter grey lines separating darker brick faces. Used for refined dungeon architecture and decorative stone construction.
nodes.pattern: regular brick grid pattern with mortar lines
nodes.game_purpose: crafted deepslate brick block, used for refined dungeon walls and decorative dark stone architecture

nodes.label: Deepslate Tiles Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of deepslate tiles. Dark charcoal-grey with a smaller, more uniform tile grid compared to deepslate bricks. Slightly shinier appearance with compact square tile divisions. Used for smooth dark tile flooring and walls in dungeon and castle aesthetics.
nodes.pattern: uniform small square tile grid with thin grout lines
nodes.game_purpose: refined deepslate tile block, used for dark tile flooring and polished dungeon surfaces

nodes.label: Deepslate Top Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture for the top face of deepslate. Dark grey with a concentric/radial ring pattern emanating from the center, giving a layered geological cross-section look. Distinguishes the top/bottom faces from side faces in game rendering.
nodes.pattern: concentric radial rings pattern, geological cross-section
nodes.game_purpose: top/bottom face variant of deepslate block, used in rendering top-face of underground stone

nodes.label: Dirt Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of dirt/soil. Warm brown palette with noisy, granular texture simulating loose earth and small soil particles. Used for ground terrain, farming layers, and general earth terrain construction.
nodes.pattern: granular noise, loose soil particle texture
nodes.game_purpose: basic earth/soil block, used for terrain ground layer, farming, and path construction

nodes.label: Gold Block Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of a solid gold block. Bright yellow/golden color with subtle cross-hatch shading pattern to give a metallic shine effect. Used as a high-value decorative or crafting material block signifying wealth or rare loot.
nodes.pattern: uniform golden surface with subtle cross-hatch shading for metallic sheen
nodes.game_purpose: high-value metal block, decorative material, rare loot or boss room indicator

nodes.label: Iron Block Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style iron block texture. Uniform light grey metallic surface with subtle pixel grid pattern and slightly darker border lines forming a square tile. Color palette: light silver-grey (#C8C8C8), off-white highlights, medium grey mortar lines. Game purpose: crafted storage block for iron ingots, used as building material and for beacon bases; indicates high-value metal resource.
nodes.pattern: uniform grid with subtle seam lines

nodes.label: Netherite Block Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style netherite block texture. Very dark charcoal/near-black surface with subtle pixel noise and faint lighter flecks suggesting the blended ancient debris composite material. Color palette: very dark grey-black (#1A1A1A to #2A2A2A) with muted brownish-grey undertones and occasional lighter pixel highlights. Game purpose: storage block for netherite ingots, the rarest and most durable crafting material; used as prestige building block and upgrade material for diamond gear.
nodes.pattern: nearly uniform dark surface with subtle pixel noise and faint grey flecks

nodes.label: Oak Planks Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style oak wood planks texture. Horizontal wood-grain banding with alternating lighter and darker tan-brown strips simulating sawn wood boards. Clear horizontal seam lines divide the planks. Color palette: warm tan-brown (#B89060), medium brown (#A07840), light cream-tan (#C8A878), darker brown grain lines. Game purpose: fundamental early-game crafting and building material derived from oak logs; used for structures, tools, crafting tables, and many recipe ingredients.
nodes.pattern: horizontal plank bands with wood-grain lines and seam divisions

nodes.label: Obsidian Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style obsidian block texture. Very dark purple-black surface with irregular swirling glassy patterns and faint violet/purple highlights suggesting volcanic glass. Pixel noise creates a mottled, crystalline appearance. Color palette: near-black base (#0A0A10), deep purple-black (#1A1025), subtle violet highlights (#2A1A3A), faint lighter specks. Game purpose: extremely blast-resistant building block obtained by water cooling lava; used for Nether portals, enchanting tables, and high-durability structures.
nodes.pattern: swirling dark glassy pattern with violet undertones and pixel noise

nodes.label: Orange Terracotta Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style orange terracotta (hardened clay) texture. Rich warm orange-burnt sienna solid color surface with very subtle pixel variation suggesting fired clay. Matte, earthy appearance with no strong patterning. Color palette: vivid orange (#C86020), burnt orange (#B85010), warm terracotta (#D07030). Game purpose: decorative building block dyed in orange; found naturally in mesa/badlands biomes and crafted by dyeing hardened clay; popular for warm-toned builds.
nodes.pattern: nearly uniform warm orange surface with faint pixel-level clay texture

nodes.label: Polished Blackstone Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style polished blackstone texture. Very dark charcoal-black surface with a smooth, refined appearance and subtle lighter pixel flecks suggesting a polished stone finish. Slightly lighter than netherite block with a more uniform, refined look. Color palette: very dark grey-charcoal (#1C1C1C to #2C2C2C) with minor lighter noise pixels. Game purpose: decorative polished variant of blackstone; crafted by polishing blackstone blocks found in the Nether; used for dark, sleek architectural builds.
nodes.pattern: smooth uniform dark surface with minimal pixel noise suggesting polished finish

nodes.label: Polished Deepslate Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style polished deepslate texture. Medium-dark grey stone surface with subtle horizontal and diagonal layering lines suggesting the slate-like cleavage of deepslate. Slightly lighter than polished blackstone, with a cool grey-blue tint. Color palette: dark grey (#3A3A3A), medium grey (#484848), slightly lighter grey (#505050) with faint blue-grey undertones. Game purpose: decorative polished variant of deepslate found deep underground (below Y=0); used for sleek, dark architectural builds; requires a pickaxe to mine.
nodes.pattern: layered grey stone pattern with subtle directional grain lines

nodes.label: Rail Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style rail (minecart track) texture. Two parallel horizontal grey metallic rails on a transparent background (rails are a non-full block/flat tile). Grey-silver rail tracks with perpendicular crossties or absent in the standard straight variant. Color palette: medium grey (#808080) rail color, off-white (#B0B0B0) highlights, transparent or black (#000000) background gaps between rails. Game purpose: flat track block placed on ground for minecarts to travel along; connects to form straight or curved paths; used for minecart transportation systems.
nodes.pattern: two parallel horizontal metallic strips (rails) with transparent/dark gaps between

nodes.label: Red Terracotta Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style red terracotta (hardened clay) texture. Deep brick-red to brownish-red solid surface with very subtle pixel variation suggesting fired clay. Matte earthy appearance, darker and more brownish than orange terracotta. Color palette: brick red (#983020), deep red-brown (#882818), slightly lighter red (#A83828). Game purpose: decorative building block dyed in red; found naturally in mesa/badlands biomes and crafted by dyeing hardened clay; popular for rustic and warm-toned architectural builds.
nodes.pattern: nearly uniform deep brick-red surface with faint pixel-level clay texture

nodes.label: Sand Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style sand block texture. Warm light yellow-beige granular surface with randomized pixel noise simulating fine sand grains. Subtle variation in pixel brightness creates a natural sandy appearance without strong directional patterning. Color palette: light sandy yellow (#D8C878), pale cream (#E0D090), medium tan (#C8B860), slightly darker grain specks (#B0A050). Game purpose: gravity-affected block found in deserts, beaches, and underwater; used for crafting sandstone, glass (when smelted), and concrete powder; also used as natural terrain filler.
nodes.pattern: randomized granular pixel noise in warm yellow-beige tones

nodes.label: Sandstone Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style sandstone side face texture. Uniform sandy yellow-beige tone with subtle grainy noise pattern and slight layered horizontal striations typical of sandstone block sides. Low contrast, warm ochre palette.

nodes.label: Sandstone Top Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style sandstone top face texture. Flat sandy yellow surface with a uniform fine-grain sandy speckle. Slightly lighter and more homogeneous than the side face, representing the smooth top of a sandstone block.

nodes.label: Sculk Block Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style sculk block texture. Very dark navy/black base with scattered small bright teal-cyan speckles or dots representing bioluminescent veins. The pattern is tall and narrow (strip or atlas slice), evoking the deep-dark biome aesthetic.

nodes.label: Sculk Catalyst Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style sculk catalyst side face texture. Dark background with glowing teal-cyan flame-like or petal protrusions at the top, characteristic of the sculk catalyst block which emits sculk-like tendrils. Three luminous teal spikes visible against the dark body.

nodes.label: Tall Grass Bottom Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style tall grass lower half texture. Thin vertical green grass blades on a transparent background, showing the base stems of tall grass. Muted medium-green tones forming sparse upright strands.

nodes.label: Tall Grass Top Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style tall grass upper half texture. Sparse grass blade tips on a transparent background, slightly thinner and more wispy than the bottom half. Medium green color with fine line detail representing the tops of tall grass blades.

nodes.label: TNT Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style TNT side face texture. Bright red body with white text reading 'TNT' in pixelated font, centered on the face. Classic iconic block texture with a bold red and white color scheme.

nodes.label: TNT Top Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style TNT top face texture. Dark background with an orange-red starburst or cross-shaped fuse/detonator pattern at the center, representing the top of a TNT block with its explosive core visible.

nodes.label: Tuff Block Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style tuff block texture. Muted dark gray-green stone surface with irregular mottled spots and a rough, noisy appearance. Represents a volcanic rock block found underground; earthy dark grey-olive palette.

nodes.label: Water Still Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style still water texture strip (animation atlas). Tall narrow strip of translucent blue-gray water frames used for animation. Each frame shows gentle ripple-like horizontal wave patterns in pale blue-grey tones, representing calm standing water.

nodes.label: Diamond Sword Texture (Root)
nodes.description: Small pixel-art icon of a diagonal sword in cyan/aqua diamond color, Minecraft-style item sprite used as a weapon texture in the game

nodes.label: Heart FX Texture
nodes.description: Small red heart icon, pixel-art style, used as a health/HP indicator or visual effect (FX) in the game UI or world

nodes.description: Small pixel-art icon of a diagonal sword in yellow/gold color, Minecraft-style item sprite used as a weapon texture in the game

nodes.description: Small pixel-art icon of a diagonal sword in grey/silver iron color, Minecraft-style item sprite used as a weapon texture in the game

nodes.description: Small pixel-art icon of a pair of boots in cyan/aqua diamond color, Minecraft-style armor item sprite for the feet slot

nodes.label: Diamond Chestplate Item Icon
nodes.description: Small pixel-art icon of a chestplate/tunic in cyan/aqua diamond color, Minecraft-style armor item sprite for the chest/torso slot

nodes.label: Diamond Leggings Item Icon

nodes.description: Small pixel-art icon of a diagonal sword in cyan/aqua diamond color, Minecraft-style weapon item sprite — items subfolder version likely for inventory/UI display

nodes.description: Small pixel-art icon of a diagonal sword in yellow/gold color, Minecraft-style weapon item sprite — items subfolder version likely for inventory/UI display

nodes.description: Pixel-art icon of iron boots armor piece, small grayscale boot silhouette in Minecraft style

nodes.label: Iron Chestplate Item Icon
nodes.description: Pixel-art icon of iron chestplate armor piece, small grayscale torso armor silhouette in Minecraft style

nodes.description: Pixel-art icon of iron helmet armor piece, small grayscale helmet silhouette in Minecraft style

nodes.label: Potato Launcher Item Icon
nodes.description: Pixel-art icon of a potato launcher ranged weapon — a crossbow-like device with a brown wooden body, dark gray barrel/stock, and a pink/red accent detail, rendered in Minecraft pixel-art style

nodes.label: Stone Sword Item Texture
nodes.description: Pixel art icon of a stone sword, rendered diagonally in grey/dark tones. Small sprite used as an item inventory icon in the game.

nodes.label: Wooden Sword Item Texture
nodes.description: Pixel art icon of a wooden sword, rendered diagonally in brown/tan tones. Small sprite used as an item inventory icon in the game.

nodes.label: Player Skin Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style player skin texture sheet. Shows a small blocky humanoid character sprite with a blue/white color scheme, with a face featuring simple dot eyes. Used for rendering the player character in-game.

nodes.label: Stone Sword Texture (root textures)
nodes.description: Pixel art stone sword sprite rendered diagonally. Appears identical in style to items/stone_sword.png — a duplicate or alternate-resolution copy stored at the root textures level.

nodes.label: Wood Sword Texture (root textures)
nodes.description: Pixel art wooden sword sprite rendered diagonally in brown tones. Appears identical in style to items/wooden_sword.png — a duplicate or alternate-resolution copy stored at the root textures level.

nodes.label: Application Logo Icon
nodes.description: Application logo featuring a space shuttle launching upward, set against a red hexagonal badge with a black border and orange/yellow flame exhaust. Used as the desktop window/app icon for the LWJGL3 desktop build.

nodes.label: libGDX App Icon 128px
nodes.description: 128x128 pixel application icon featuring the same space-shuttle-on-red-hexagon badge as the logo. Used as a high-resolution window/taskbar icon for the libGDX LWJGL3 desktop application.

nodes.label: libGDX App Icon 16px
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel application icon — the smallest size of the space-shuttle badge icon. Used as a favicon-sized window icon for the libGDX LWJGL3 desktop application.

nodes.description: Resource pack icon showing a 3D-rendered mace weapon with a blocky dark grey head with hollow socket details, purple-blue handle, floating with wind/cloud pixel-art decoration elements on a white background. Minecraft resource pack promotional image.
